content.short: Crypto exchange app that auto-matches you with the best P2P and licensed providers for USDT and USDC.
content.description: UNIGOX collects offers from peer-to-peer merchants and licensed exchanges and automatically picks the best rate when users buy or sell USDT and USDC with local currency. Every fiat payment is verified cryptographically, which removes much of the usual P2P risk, and withdrawals carry no gas fees. It works in more than 100 countries and also lets companies launch their own neobank on its stack in about four weeks.
content.meta: Buy and sell USDT and USDC at the best P2P or licensed rate in 100+ countries with UNIGOX's auto-matching app.
